body: Create a 4:5 photo-booth print with four photos in a 2-by-2 grid. Use a cobalt curtain, direct flash and subtle film grain. Preserve both reference identities. Reference image 1 is the person on the left; reference image 2 is the person on the right in every panel. Preserve their facial features, skin tones and hairstyles. Show relaxed smiles, exaggerated surprise, shared laughter and a playful shoulder lean, in reading order. Add a cream paper border with the readable caption "Better together" below the four photos. Keep both faces clear and fully inside every frame. No extra text, logos or watermarks.

instructions.en: Upload the first adult portrait, then the second adult portrait. Image 1 stays on the left; image 2 stays on the right. The demonstration uses AI-generated fictional people. Keep all lettering in English.
instructions.zh-Hans: 依次上传第一位和第二位成年人的肖像。图 1 保持在左，图 2 保持在右。示例采用 AI 生成的虚构人物。画面文字保持英文。

en.title: Bestie Photo Booth
en.description: Combine two portraits into four playful photo-booth moments with a film-print finish.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload the first adult portrait, then the second adult portrait. Image 1 stays on the left; image 2 stays on the right. The demonstration uses AI-generated fictional people. Keep all lettering in English.

## What to check

Inspect identity, layout and every requested caption at full size and at phone display size.

zh-Hans.title: 好友照片亭四连拍
zh-Hans.description: 将两张人物肖像变成带胶片质感的四张好友照片亭合影。
zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

依次上传第一位和第二位成年人的肖像。图 1 保持在左，图 2 保持在右。示例采用 AI 生成的虚构人物。画面文字保持英文。

## 检查重点

核对主体一致性、构图与指定配字，并在原尺寸和手机展示尺寸检查。

alt.en: Four photo-booth images of two friends against a cobalt curtain, framed by a cream border reading Better together.
alt.zh-Hans: 钴蓝幕布前两位朋友的四张照片亭合影，米色边框写着 Better together。
